description: Get the TEXT of a Colorado administrative regulation (Code of Colorado Regulations, CCR) by citation, with its effective date. "1 CCR 212-3" is the Colorado Marijuana Rules; pass rule="2-245" to read one rule inside it (e.g. change of owner / transfer of ownership), or omit rule to page through the document (rule_index lists the rule numbers). Returns the current version by default, plus filing type, adopted date, Colorado Register publication and the list of earlier effective dates; pass effective_date for an earlier version. Naming only an agency (e.g. "2 CCR 502") returns that agency's document list. Colorado Secretary of State, live, keyless. Statutes are co_statute; this is the regulations.

ccr_number.description: CCR citation, e.g. "1 CCR 212-3" (Colorado Marijuana Rules) or "2 CCR 502-1". Volume, agency number, dash, document number.

effective_date.description: Optional. YYYY-MM-DD effective date of an earlier version (listed in archived_effective_dates). Omit for the current version.

max_chars.description: Max characters of text to return (default 30000, max 100000).

offset.description: Character offset to continue a long text from next_offset.

rule.description: Optional rule number inside the document, e.g. "2-245" or "1-105". Omit to read from the start of the document.

name: co_regulation
title: Co Regulation
